title: Dependabot triage policy
description: state/dependabot-repos.json — the repos dependabot-triage.yml may act on and how. Keys under repos are short names under the example-org org. A repo absent here is never touched. verify_checks is an allowlist of check-run names that vouch for a bump; [] means label-only, never merge.

automerge.description: default per-repo automerge when the repo does not say

zero_x_minor_is_major.description: 0.y.z minor bumps (and any 0.0.z change) classify as major

pool.description: GitHub handles rotated through for needs-human PRs (pr_number mod active pool)

exclude.description: handles whose existing review request does NOT count as 'already has a reviewer'

verify_checks.description: check-run names that must all be SUCCESS on the PR head before a minor/patch bump may merge
